summary: Cellyan Biotechnology filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on November 10, 2026 Chairman Lap Sun Wong resigned as Chairman and director, and independent director Zhao Letao resigned from the board and its audit, compensation and governance committees, leaving the Chairman office vacant. Neither cited disagreement. The board appointed CFO Shu Liu as executive director and Xiaohu Quan as independent director effective November 11, filling Zhao's committee seats and compensation chair. Five directors remain, three independent. Watch for further attrition or governance strain under the Nasdaq independence framework.
